simple.meaning: מָשַׁל (mâshal) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to rule.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 82 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, and 18 more, beginning at Genesis 1:18. Its contexts include family, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָשַׁל (H4910).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מָשַׁל (mâshal) / H4910 is traced through Genesis 1:18, Genesis 3:16, Genesis 4:7, Genesis 24:2 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.usage: (have, make to have) dominion, governor, × indeed, reign, (bear, cause to, have) rule(-ing, -r), have power.
